title: A feature flag that saves itself

task.text: An active record is a row object that also carries its own finders and persistence.
Complete `FeatureFlag`. The skeleton, the private table and `reset()` are given; keep the table private and static.

items: `create(name, percent)` returns an unsaved, disabled flag. Throw `IllegalArgumentException` for a blank name or a percent outside 0 to 100. `rollout(p)` applies the same rule.
`save()` inserts or updates and returns `this`. Saving a never-persisted flag whose name is taken throws `IllegalStateException`.
`find(name)` returns a fresh object each time. Unsaved edits never show in the table.
`all()` returns fresh objects sorted by name.
`delete()` removes the row and clears `persisted()`; deleting an unsaved flag does nothing.

checks.title: create checks the name and percent
A new flag is stored only by save
find builds a fresh object, edits stay local
Edit then save updates the same row
all lists flags sorted by name
A second new flag with the same name is rejected
Finders are static, save and delete are on the record
The table is a private static map

hints.text: Two jobs live in one class: the object holds fields and rules, and it also knows how to read and write its own row. Finders cannot use an instance, so they are static.
Store immutable `Row` values in `TABLE`, not the flag objects. `find` builds a new `FeatureFlag` from a row and marks it persisted. `save` writes a new `Row` from the current fields.
